task: T1: write scripts/run-key.sh, a standalone reader in the same shape as scripts/spec-field.sh — one job, sourced by nobody, executable on its own so the gate can probe it directly. Printing the host discriminator of spec.md section 3.1 on stdout with a trailing newline and exiting 0: `$RALPH_HOST_ID` if set and non-empty, else `hostname`, else the literal `unknown`. It must NEVER print an empty line and must NEVER exit nonzero — a discriminator that can fail is a loop that can fail, and outcome 8 forbids that. Sanitise the result to `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` and replace every other byte with a single `_`, using `tr` (POSIX, identical on macOS and Linux) and NOT bash pattern substitution. A dash is legal here and must survive: this becomes a directory name, and a k8s pod name like `harness-run-7` must pass through intact. Do not touch any other file in this task.
